failure_classes.root_cause: A retry with an argument or staging-identity error could seal an adaptive capture with no successful host tool log and count the resulting abstention as complete.
failure_classes.repair: Adaptive collaboration sealing now requires at least one successful staged observation. Zero-log and all-error captures fail before artifact completion; baseline no-tool captures remain permitted.

failure_classes.root_cause: The model placed COBOL implementation facts in the verifier claim field. The frozen lexical citation backend correctly rejected claims not entailed by the legal clause.
failure_classes.repair: The successor prompt and response schema require a clause-grounded regulatory proposition in claim and place code facts in prediction rationale, static evidence, and the final answer.

failure_classes.root_cause: The model proposed D2 after positive required-tool observations and invented unstated date-derivation requirements for conformant cases.
failure_classes.repair: The successor prompt rejects D2 after any positive required-tool observation, forbids invented implementation requirements, and directs positively matching cases to D7 when no supported drift remains.

failure_classes.root_cause: The rationale abbreviated the regulated enum member instead of copying one complete canonical missing or extra member.
failure_classes.repair: The successor prompt requires a complete canonical member verbatim, including prefixes and punctuation. The host guard remains unchanged.

failure_classes.root_cause: The model changed one nibble of a host-returned observation SHA-256. Host staging and verification hashes agreed.
failure_classes.repair: Fail-closed hash validation remains unchanged; the successor prompt adds an exact-copy preflight and malformed attempts require a fresh retry.

additional_class_arbitration_repair.observed_problem: Several train/dev D3 rows were proposed as D1 and D7 rows were proposed as D2.
additional_class_arbitration_repair.repair: The successor prompt requires enumeration of all typed loci before D1, gives D3 precedence for conflicting reachable outcomes, and prevents D2 from substituting an unstated implementation mechanism for the regulated rule.

governance: Method-affecting changes are un-frozen configuration-4 train/dev engineering. Configuration-3 lineage-v4 remains immutable and is not relabeled.
